newsitem.title: USA: Quadrax unaware of why stock price dipped.
newsitem.headline: Quadrax unaware of why stock price dipped.

text.p: Quadrax Corp said Wednesday that it was not aware of any corporate development that would cause the recent decline in its stock price.
James J. Palermo, chairman and chief executive officer, said Quadrax was surprised by the recent behavior of the company's stock price.

"In fact, we are now producing and shipping more products than ever before and we are experiencing continued increases in monthly sales and shipment of golf shafts, hockey sticks, lacrosse sticks and handlebars," he said.
He said the company recently hired more production personnel to keep up with the growing demand for its products.
"Based on increasing demand and commitments for our products going forward, we expect the growing monthly sales and shipments to continue for the remainder of the year," he said.
In January, Quadrax said it had been named in a patent suit by Advanced Pultrusion Technology Ltd and its subsidiary, Power Stock Manufacturing Inc.

Quadrax said the lawsuit was related to the hockey stick pultrusion machine and related equipment it acquired when it bought the assets of Vega USA in June 1996. It said in January that the claims in the suit were without merit and added that the suit would have no bearing on its golf operations, or on any of its other products.
Quadrax produces thermoplastic composite materials used in the production of commercial and consumer products.
Its stock closed 5/32 to 11/16 in late afternoon trading on the Nasdaq but off its 52-week high of 2-1/16.
